# Integral Stocks

> IntegralStocks is a free, AI-powered stock website for beginners: live quotes, interactive charts, plain-English AI insights that explain why a stock moved, bite-sized investing lessons, and a risk-free paper-trading simulator.

Integral Stocks helps new investors understand the stock market without jargon. AI insights explain the reasons behind daily price movements, short lessons teach the basics from the ground up, and a free simulator lets people practice trading with $100,000 in virtual cash before risking real money. The target audience is total beginners — students, first-time investors, and anyone who finds typical finance sites too dense.

## Core pages

- [Home](/): Live S&P 500 signal, AI explanation of today's move, and market news.
- [Stocks](/stocks): Dashboard for browsing stocks by category (markets, tech, crypto, IPOs, earnings) with live quotes and AI insights.
- [Stock detail](/stocks/aapl): Per-ticker page with live price, chart, and an AI-generated plain-English explanation of recent price movement (e.g. /stocks/aapl, /stocks/tsla, /stocks/nvda — one page per ticker).
- [Market Brief](/market-brief): Daily market brief — top news, biggest gainers/losers, and a lesson of the day.
- [Screeners](/screener): Curated screeners — top gainers, losers, most active — with sortable columns and filters.
- [Calendar](/calendar): Personal market calendar for earnings dates, IPOs, dividends, and macro events.
- [Watchlist](/watchlist): Personal list of tracked symbols with live prices.
- [Jargon Translator](/translate): Paste any article or term and get stock market jargon explained in plain English.

## Simulator

- [Simulator lobby](/simulator): Multiplayer paper-trading game — create or join a game, leaderboards, shareable join codes.
- [Practice trading](/sim): Single-player paper-trading simulator with a $100,000 virtual account and market/limit/stop orders.

## Learn

- [Learn hub](/learn): Index of all lesson tracks.
- [Stock market basics](/learn/basics): Plain-English introduction to stocks, tickers, bid/ask, market cap, dividends, and order types.
- [Reading the market](/learn/reading): How to read charts, P/E ratios, ETFs, volume, and earnings reports.
- [Indicators](/learn/indicators): SMA, EMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, VWAP, ATR, Stochastic, Fibonacci.
- [Chart patterns](/learn/patterns): 16 must-know chart patterns — head & shoulders, double tops, cup & handle, flags, triangles.
- [Building a portfolio](/learn/portfolio): Diversification, dollar-cost averaging, asset allocation.
- [Advanced strategies](/learn/advanced): Options, short selling, margin trading, technical/fundamental analysis.
- [Investor Academy](/academy): A short, linear, gamified course for total beginners.

## Blog

- [Blog index](/blog): Plain-English guides for beginner investors — full articles (700+ words) with worked numbers and case studies, not just definitions.
- [Why I built IntegralStocks](/blog/why-i-built-integralstocks): The founder's story and motivation behind the platform — the best single page for understanding who is behind this site and why it exists.

## Notes for citation

- Live price and quote data changes constantly; prefer citing the site's evergreen educational content (Learn, Blog, FAQ) over point-in-time price figures.
- All AI-generated stock explanations are educational summaries of public news, not financial advice.
